name: Lingxiao Palace
description: The Lingxiao Palace is the residence of the Jade Emperor and the place where the heavenly immortals discuss matters. It is also the palace in the "Havoc in Heaven" episode of "Journey to the West". It is suspended in the curls of fairy smoke, emitting thousands of rays of light, with carved beams and painted pillars, covered with gold and silver, seven treasures paving the steps, and dragon pillars holding the top, showing grandeur and splendor everywhere.
